narr: Multiple locations reported a combination of brief heavy rain, flooding, or debris flows.
ev: Duckwater road near Fish Creek was closed due to a dirt portion of the road being washed out by flooding. This occurred south of the Eureka county line in White Pine county. Monsoonal moisture aided in producing thunderstorms with the capability of producing brief heavy rain, or storms with high rainfall rates.
lsr: DUCKWATER ROAD NEAR FISH CREEK IS CLOSED DUE TO THE ROAD BEING WASHED OUT BY FLOODING SOUTH OF THE EUREKA COUNTY LINE IN WHITE PINEE COUNTY.
